records.title: Forest Area (Including Mangroves)
records.footnote: Data are taken from the Food and Agriculture Organisation's (FAO) Global Forest Resources Assessments 2020 report and may be periodically updated when the next FRA report is available. For more information, please refer to Singapore's FRA2020 report (https://fra-data.fao.org/assessments/fra/2020/SGP/home/overview). The denominator throughout the time series is fixed as the area of Singapore in 2015, as determined by FAOSTAT. Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 15.1.1 and 15.2.1.
